title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior emerges and evolves in a population under the influence of social networks, policy interventions, information (including misinformation), and supply constraints, optionally coupled with disease transmission effects.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe peers in their social network and update adoption probability based on neighbors' mask use and personal conformity/trust parameters.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Government mandates and location-level enforcement affect individuals' compliance; noncompliance may incur penalties.

interactions.name: information_exposure
interactions.description: Media outlets broadcast messages that change risk perception and trust; misinformation can decrease adoption.

interactions.name: purchase_transaction
interactions.description: Individuals buy masks from retailers subject to price, subsidies, income, and stock availability.

interactions.name: household_norms_and_sharing
interactions.description: Households share masks and reinforce norms, influencing member adoption.

interactions.name: workplace_school_requirements
interactions.description: Workplaces and schools apply context-specific mask rules that affect compliance during attendance.

interactions.name: infection_transmission
interactions.description: Contacts at locations can transmit infection; probability is modified by mask use, ventilation, and mask efficacy.

interactions.name: supply_chain_restock
interactions.description: Retailers restock from external supply with delays and capacity limits, affecting price and availability.

metrics.name: mask_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Share of the population wearing a mask at a given time (overall and by context).

metrics.name: time_to_70_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until overall mask adoption first reaches 70%.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_days_above_80
metrics.description: Total days with adoption at or above 80%.

metrics.name: average_compliance_under_mandate
metrics.description: Mean compliance rate in contexts with an active mandate.

metrics.name: incidence_per_100k
metrics.description: Daily new infections per 100,000 people (if disease module enabled).

metrics.name: effective_reproduction_number_Re
metrics.description: Estimated effective reproduction number considering mask effects and contacts (if disease module enabled).

metrics.name: cases_averted_vs_baseline
metrics.description: Cumulative infections prevented compared to a no-mask baseline scenario (if disease module enabled).

metrics.name: adoption_equity_gap
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between highest and lowest income quintiles.

metrics.name: retailer_stockout_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of days retailers have zero stock available.

metrics.name: average_mask_price
metrics.description: Mean price paid per mask over the simulation period.

metrics.name: penalties_collected
metrics.description: Total fines collected due to noncompliance.

metrics.name: misinformation_prevalence
metrics.description: Share of the population recently exposed to misinformation messages.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_curve_stability
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate stabilizes (change < 1 percentage point over 14 days) by the end of the simulation.

validation_criteria.name: no_negative_inventories
validation_criteria.description: Retailer and household mask inventories never drop below zero.

validation_criteria.name: s_curve_fit
validation_criteria.description: Adoption trajectory fits a logistic (S-shaped) curve with R^2 >= 0.8 under typical parameters.

validation_criteria.name: mandate_effect_directionality
validation_criteria.description: Average compliance increases when mandates are active compared to periods without mandates.

validation_criteria.name: efficacy_consistency
validation_criteria.description: Observed reduction in Re at high adoption is within ±5% of the theoretical reduction implied by mask efficacy parameters (if disease module enabled).
